pages.text: $(bold)Child of the Stars$() (default trait of Ashen Ink)$(br2)Effect: increases the $(bold)final damage$() you deal to $(bold)twice$() its original value, doubling again with each level (×2^level).$(br2)Final damage = the damage remaining after armor, enchantments, potions and all other layers of calculation, so this boost is extremely powerful.$(br2)Trigger: a passive that is always active — no action required.
